Marketing Coordinator

About Us:
We are a growing company that was founded over a decade ago with a simple idea:
put people first. Since then we have grown into a recognized name, and we have
never lost sight of what got us here. Our culture is everything to us. We believe
that work should be fun, that colleagues should feel like family, and that the
best ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. We have been recognized as
a great place to work, and we are proud of the environment we have built together.

Our Mission:
Our mission is to make a difference in the lives of the people we serve. Every
day we come to work energized by that purpose. We are on an exciting journey and
we are just getting started. If that sounds like the kind of place where you
would thrive, we would love to hear from you.

The Opportunity:
You will be part of a collaborative team in a role with a lot of variety. No two
days are the same here. This is a chance to make a real impact and to grow with
us as we scale. You will have the opportunity to take on new challenges and to
broaden your horizons in ways you may not expect.

Responsibilities:
- Support the team with a wide variety of tasks
- Help out wherever needed across the department
- Contribute to team meetings and brainstorming sessions
- Other duties as assigned

Who You Are:
- A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment
- Self-starter with a positive attitude
- Excellent communication skills
- Detail-oriented and highly motivated
- Passionate about our mission
- Wears many hats and can hit the ground running
- Problem solver who thinks outside the box
- Someone who works well with others and wants to grow

Why Join Us:
We offer competitive compensation, a generous benefits package, and a supportive
environment where you can do your best work. We invest in our people because our
people are what make us who we are. Come be part of something special.
